schedules.name: Weekend results and performance review
schedules.when: Monday 10:00 (scheduled a few minutes early to avoid on-the-hour queueing)

schedules.name: Midweek fixture analysis
schedules.window: Monday to Thursday of the current week, fixtures not yet kicked off
schedules.outputs: reports/midweek/YYYY-MM-DD/ (english, european, combined PDFs + CSV + JSON), reports/chatgpt_review/chatgpt_review_YYYY-MM-DD_midweek.md

schedules.name: Weekend fixture analysis
schedules.window: Friday to Sunday of the coming weekend

mechanics: Each run is a fresh cloud session that must have Rob's PC linked (Claude desktop app open): the API pull (py download.py --results) runs on the PC, the analysis runs in the cloud workspace, outputs are written back to the PC folder. Push and email notification on completion. No Friday or Saturday runs; manual runs remain available via the skill.
